👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
 Doston, Bharat aaj ek aisi disha mein badh raha hai jahan hum koi bhi badi galti afford nahi kar sakte! Kyunki jis tarah China ek gareeb desh se superpower bana, ussi raftaar se aaj Bharat bhi upar uthne ki koshish kar raha hai. Humein 1 trillion dollar GDP tak pahunchne mein 60 saal lage, phir 1 se 2 trillion jaane mein sirf 7 saal, 2 se 3 trillion mein 5 saal, aur ab hum aisi speed pakad chuke hain jahan har 2 saal mein ek trillion dollar humare GDP mein add karne wale hain! Lekin doston, jahan Bharat itni tez raftaar se badh raha hai, hamare padosi Pakistan ki kahani ek sakht warning ban chuki hai. Aaj Pakistan ek gehre energy crisis mein dooba hua hai  aur woh bhi ek aisi galti ki wajah se, jo humare politicians bhi kar sakte hain!!!

 Isliye Bharat ke liye sabse zaroori hai ki hum apne growth ke is golden phase mein woh galtiyan repeat na karein. Kyunki doston, dekha jaaye toh dono deshon ke politicians kahin na kahin same game khelte hain!! Dono deshon mein votes ke liye freebies baate jaate hain, election ke time logon ko sapne dikhaye jaate hain, aur jab long-term policy ki baat aati hai, toh desh se zyada politicians apni kursi ke baare mein sochte hain! Isliye aaj aapko Bharat mein bhi free bijli, free ration aur free cash transfers jaise vaade sunne ko milte hain… Aur yahi galti Pakistan ne kari, jiski wajah se aaj Pakistan ki halat itni kharab ho chuki hai ki aaj wahan logon ke rent se zyada unke electricity bills hain!! Bina electricity ke pura desh karz mein dooba hua hai aur growth ka namo-nishan nahi dikh raha! And right now Pakistan is dying without energy!!!

Aur pata hai sabse disturbing fact kya hai?? Politicians aur businessmen itna paisa kama chuke hain ki aap soch bhi nahi sakte! Lekin ek aam aadmi ke paas khane tak ke paise nahi hain!! In fact, inflation in Pakistan even touched 30% in 2023 and 12% in 2024! Can you believe that?? Aur ye sab shuru hua bas ek bewakoof political mistake se! Jo Bharat ke politicians bhi kar sakte hain... Toh sawaal ye hai 
Pakistan ne aisi kaunsi galtiyan kari jiski wajah se woh aaj itne bade energy crisis mein hain?
Pakistan ke politicians se kya galti hui? 
Aur Bharat ke politicians Pakistan ki is galti se kya seekh sakte hain?
